snippet.title: Santrel Media
snippet.description:
Based out of Philadelphia, Santrel Media offers innovative marketing solutions to improve business profitability and efficiency, with a focus on the cross-departmental customer experience. We deliver business growth through quantifiable marketing programs that drive leads, support sales, and strengthen efficiency.

​
Santrel was born out of necessity. In our fast-changing world, it is essential for businesses to have an effective marketing strategy which provides a positive return on investment and increases brand awareness.  For some businesses, organic marketing is optimal, for others, paid advertising is better, and for most, we incorporate a combination of the two.  At Santrel, we push our clients into the most effective & efficient marketing channels of the current year. Not 10 years ago.

snippet.title: Julia McCoy
snippet.description:
The world's first 100% AI clone, humanly-run channel on AI news. Welcome to the rabbit hole. 🐇 🕳️ 

I've successfully cloned myself and my knowledge so I can stay in my zone of genius while helping millions steward humanity's greatest age of abundance.

I explore AI news from the non-hype, critical perspective of an AI founder, and Jesus-follower.

As the founder of First Movers, it’s my job to study career and job impact from artificial intelligence + quantum technology, as well as the future of our world (AGI, post labor economics, and UBI).

I show you how to ditch centuries-old programming and find your passion and meaning, which I believe is the best way to get ready for what's coming with the decoupling of labor and capital. I tell you the trends in AI and tech you should be aware of, while avoiding the hype and clickbait, one video at a time.

I want to help millions of folks, just like you, adapt successfully to the new AI age.

Subscribe for new videos weekly.

snippet.title: Shimmy Morris
snippet.description:
Hey 👋🏻 I'm Shimmy. I make money by creating bestselling designs and I teach others how they can too. 

I started designing when I was very young, but I've specifically focused on T-shirts and Print on Demand since 2014. I built a system that allows me to create best-selling designs over and over again, and that's what I share on this YouTube channel and in my community, Design Hub. 

You'll find all sorts of cool stuff here, templates, guides, infographics, tips, tricks and systems to start making designs that become Bestsellers. 

If you have questions, feel free to ask, and I'll happily respond in the comments. Thanks for reading!

snippet.title: Passive Income with Mey
snippet.description:
Hey, I'm Mey, and I teach creative people how to find alignment & success in their online  businesses. 
I started this channel on January 7th 2021 in order to share multiple ways to make money from your creativity-
Print on demand, affiliate marketing, selling printables / digital downloads, building blogs, and more! 
However, 4 years after- this channel has grown to be so much more... It became a community!
Slowly, in the past few months, I have been shifting my content to give creative people a larger view on making money online. From discussing the mindset of starting an online business, the ways to create a stable business with multiple streams of income, and most importantly- how to create the business that is aligned with YOU, your values, and your abilities.

snippet.title: JAY'S WAY - Jay De Souza
snippet.description:
I quit my toxic corporate job in 2012 and opened my first Etsy shop as a side-hustle in 2013. 
In 2023 my wife and I left an increasingly toxic North America (Canada) for a simpler life in Belize on a tiny 5km (3 mile) long island. 
I'm here to help: I want to see as many people as possible regain control of their time (& money) and do it by avoiding all the mistakes I made along the way.
🌎 We only get one kick at this "can" called "Life" - It's not a dress rehearsal.. so get busy putting yourself first! 🌎

snippet.description:

Over the past 5 years, I’ve built multiple 7-figure apparel brands and learned a ton about what actually drives sales, beyond hype and theory.

I started this channel to make real POD education accessible: no paywalls, no fluff, no holding back. No matter your background or budget, you deserve clear steps that work.

If my content can save you from the mistakes I made on the way up, that’s a win.

Want a FREE, step-by-step course to go from startup to scale-up? Join my free WeScale community—51+ hours of training, templates, and resources. (Link below)

snippet.title: Rochelle Be
snippet.description:
OK — you got me. I’m obsessed with online income and I’m here to help you get yours 🌸

Hey, I’m Rochelle!

I’m a 35-year-old digital product entrepreneur & business coach from London.

After 15 years in what felt like corporate prison — and wasting a LOT of money on failed side hustles — I finally discovered the cheat code to freedom: selling digital products.

Specifically low-ticket digital products, using simple AI, to build an (almost) passive online income business without constantly posting on social media.

I truly believe God put me on this earth to help people make their own money, so you never have to financially rely on anyone ever again.

Subscribe for videos on how to create, sell, and scale digital products that actually make money.

I drop free trainings weekly, so hit subscribe so you don’t miss any gems 💎
